verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.pt: Compadece-te de mim, ó Deus, pois homens me calcam aos pés e, pelejando, me aflingem o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Jonath elem rehokim. Of David. Michtam. When the Philistines took him in Gath.> Have mercy on me, O God, for man is attempting my destruction; every day he makes cruel attacks against me.

verses.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.pt: Os meus inimigos me calcam aos pés o dia todo, pois são muitos os que insolentemente pelejam contra mim.
verses.en_web: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
verses.en_bbe: My haters are ever ready to put an end to me; great numbers are lifting themselves up against me.

verses.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.pt: No dia em que eu temer, hei de confiar em ti.
verses.en_web: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
verses.en_bbe: In the time of my fear, I will have faith in you.

verses.en: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.pt: Em Deus, cuja palavra eu lovo, em Deus ponho a minha confiança e não terei medo;
verses.en_web: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
verses.en_bbe: In God will I give praise to his word; in God have I put my hope; I will have no fear of what flesh may do to me.

verses.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.pt: Todos os dias torcem as minhas palavras; todos os seus pensamentos são contra mim para o mal.
verses.en_web: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.en_bbe: Every day they make wrong use of my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.pt: Ajuntam-se, escondem-se, espiam os meus passos, como que aguardando a minha morte.
verses.en_web: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.
verses.en_bbe: They come together, they are waiting in secret places, they take note of my steps, they are waiting for my soul.

verses.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.pt: Escaparão eles por meio da sua iniqüidade? Ó Deus, derruba os povos na tua ira!
verses.en_web: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
verses.en_bbe: By evil-doing they will not get free from punishment. In wrath, O God, let the peoples be made low.

verses.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.pt: Tu contaste as minhas aflições; põe as minhas lágrimas no teu odre; não estão elas no teu livro?
verses.en_web: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
verses.en_bbe: You have seen my wanderings; put the drops from my eyes into your bottle; are they not in your record?

verses.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
verses.pt: No dia em que eu te invocar retrocederão os meus inimigos; isto eu sei, que Deus está comigo.
verses.en_web: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.
verses.en_bbe: When I send up my cry to you, my haters will be turned back; I am certain of this, for God is with me.

verses.en: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
verses.pt: Em Deus, cuja palavra eu louvo, no Senhor, cuja palavra eu louvo,
verses.en_web: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
verses.en_bbe: In God will I give praise to his word; in the Lord will I give praise to his word.

verses.en: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.pt: em Deus ponho a minha confiança, e não terei medo; que me pode fazer o homem?
verses.en_web: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.en_bbe: In God have I put my hope, I will have no fear of what man may do to me.

verses.en: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.pt: Sobre mim estão os votos que te fiz, ó Deus; eu te oferecerei ações de graças;
verses.en_web: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
verses.en_bbe: I keep the memory of my debt to you, O God; I will give you the offerings of praise.

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.pt: pois tu livraste a minha alma da morte. Não livraste também os meus pés de tropeçarem, para que eu ande diante de Deus na luz da vida?
verses.en_web: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have taken my soul from the power of death; and kept my feet from falling, so that I may be walking before God in the light of life.
